styleIdentity.description: Retro 2D pixel-art side-scroller with flat geometric structures, muted earth tones, dark night sky, and crisp blocky characters.

composition.foreground: Railway tracks and dark floor plane at bottom.
composition.midground: Scavenger character standing on platform in front of wall.
composition.background: Dark sky with layered horizontal flat tones.
composition.objectScale: Human-scale props (bench, framed picture, lamp post, signs).
composition.characterScale: Small sprite relative to environment height (~1/4 screen height).
composition.density: Low to moderate density with clean horizontal banding.

lighting.direction: Ambient flat lighting with local accent highlights.
lighting.softness: Hard-edged flat pixel lighting without soft gradients.
lighting.contrast: Moderate contrast between dark backgrounds and gold accent lights.

character.proportions: Chibi 2-head-tall pixel sprite with blocky limbs.
character.poseLanguage: Frontal standing pose with rigid vertical stance.
character.clothing: Dark uniform with gold belt, wide-brim hat, dark pants.
character.faceAbstraction: Minimalist pixel face with simple dark eye pixels on pale square head.

environment.architecture: Flat wooden-walled structures with simple rectangular cutouts and frames.
environment.terrain: Flat platform surface above dark gravel rail bed.
environment.props: Wooden benches, framed posters, circular lamp posts, railway lines.
environment.textureDensity: Low pixel texture density using solid fill blocks and flat shading.

shapeLanguage: Rectangular building modules and wide horizontal bands.
Simple triangles for distant peaks and posters.
Small circular accents for lights and clock icons.
constraints: Use 2D side-view orthographic perspective for platformer alignment.
Maintain crisp pixel grid without anti-aliasing or smoothing filters.
Keep color palette constrained to defined flat tones and stepped shades.
Ensure character and interactive props contrast clearly against backgrounds.

identity: Post-apocalyptic wasteland and abandoned rail station theme
Low-resolution blocky sprites with clean flat shapes
constraints: Hard-edged pixel artwork with limited flat palette.
